title: Prevent users from adding ability points to their own posts
description:
I need help building a restriction that prevents users from adding ability points to their own posts.

Requirements:
- Review the current ability points interaction on posts.
- Users should not be able to award ability points to posts they created themselves.
- Update the frontend and backend logic as needed so self-awarding is blocked reliably.
- Ensure the UI does not present misleading interaction states for a user’s own post.
- Confirm the rule is enforced securely and cannot be bypassed through client-side requests.

Read .claude/instructions.md and create a new task in .claude/tasks/current-task.md. Break this down into phases and create a task list.
